result.reason: The operative clause reaches the preferred limits for CGL, E&O, cyber liability, and workers’ compensation, and requires certificates on request. Because TrueLink handles borrower credit data, the USD 5 million cyber requirement applies. The edit preserves the force majeure provision and unrelated commercial intent. It is not minimal, however, because requiring every policy—including CGL and workers’ compensation—to remain in force for one year after the term is not required by the playbook and is less precise than applying any tail requirement only to claims-made coverages. Express reference to privacy liability would also better track the playbook.
